item.title: Kansas schools could be required to verify family income for every student receiving free lunch
item.description: A proposed bill would require school districts to verify the gross household income of every student who receives free or reduced-price lunches. Federal law requires schools to verify a random sample amounting to 3% of recipients. Continue reading ...

item.title: Students of Lawrence schools to perform in annual Ovation! talent show
item.description: The 10th annual Ovation! talent show, set for Sunday, will highlight Lawrence Public Schools' young singers, dancers, musicians and more. Continue reading ...

item.title: Fatal shooting at Hawk stemmed from argument with bar staff, Lawrence police allege
item.description: A confrontation at the Hawk, a popular bar near KU’s campus, escalated from a dispute with bar staff members to gunfire that killed an 18-year-old and left a 16-year-old critically injured, court records show. Continue reading ...

item.title: Young artists of Van Go, community celebrate new mural at downtown Lawrence bridal shop
item.description: Community members gathered Friday afternoon to celebrate the completion of the latest mural by the young artists of Van Go. The mural now decorates a wall of J.Lynn Bridal & Suiting in downtown Lawrence. Continue reading ...
